description: Exercise clean EOF before dispatch, EOF after dispatch, and EOF in a partial frame.

subcases.name: after-dispatch-clean-boundary
requiredBehavior: Stop accepting requests and cancel the owned root/subtree.
Wait only for bounded cleanup; do not claim complete success if terminal/artifact evidence is absent.
Never automatically resubmit after a client restart.

subcases.name: mid-frame
requiredBehavior: Classify partial-frame EOF as protocol error.
Never dispatch the incomplete JSON object.
Return nonzero where process status remains available.
